hero.lead: TimeTracker records the days you actually work, turns them into an invoice, and shows what the month was worth.
hero.frameLabel: TimeTracker dashboard: weekly hours, earnings, chart, projects and invoices

journey.heading: Scroll through the product
journey.frameLabel: The TimeTracker interface: dashboard, calendar, projects, invoice and reports

dashboard.title: Know where your time went.
dashboard.body: Hours this week against your target, what they are worth, which projects are moving and which invoices are still open.
dashboard.label: Dashboard: weekly hours, earnings, chart, projects and invoices

calendar.title: Your work, day by day.
calendar.body: One entry per day — hours, client, rate, status. Worked, day off, vacation and sick leave all live on the same grid.
calendar.label: Calendar: September 2026 grid with hours and amounts

projects.title: Every hour knows who it belongs to.
projects.body: The client carries the rate, the project carries the budget. Change a rate and the old one stays on the hours it was earned on.
projects.label: Projects and clients: budgets, hours and rates

invoices.title: Turn work into an invoice.
invoices.body: Pick a period and the timesheet becomes line items — quantity, rate, VAT, numbering, PDF.
invoices.label: Invoice built from the month's hours

reports.title: See what the month was worth.
reports.body: Hours per project, per client, per month — with CSV and PDF export when the accountant asks.
reports.label: Reports: hours chart and split by project

automation.heading: Your calendar can fill itself.
automation.lead: Give TimeTracker your week and your trips. It writes the hours you actually worked — and leaves out the Sundays and the weeks you spent at home.

skipReasons.weekday_off: Weekday switched off in the schedule
skipReasons.entry_exists: An entry already exists for this day
skipReasons.automation_disabled: Automation was off at the time

dayEntries.title: Day entries
dayEntries.body: Hours or piecework quantity, status, notes, tags — one dialog per day.

clientRates.title: Client rates
clientRates.body: Rate history with effective dates; past hours keep the rate they were earned on.

projectBudgets.title: Project budgets
projectBudgets.body: Budget, utilisation, deadline and status on every project.

invoiceBuilder.title: Invoice builder
invoiceBuilder.body: Line items, buyer details, VAT, numbering series and three templates.

reports.title: Reports & export
reports.body: Range filters, comparison to the previous period, CSV and PDF export.

workAutomation.title: Work automation
workAutomation.body: A weekly schedule plus trips — the calendar writes the days you worked.

weeklyEmail.title: Weekly summary e-mail
weeklyEmail.body: The week that closed, sent to your inbox.

currencies.title: PLN and EUR
currencies.body: Rates in either currency, converted where the numbers have to meet.

themes.title: Themes
themes.body: Five colour palettes, light and dark.

finalCta.heading: Start the clock. The rest follows.

footer.tagline: The clock, the calendar and the invoice in one place.
